answer: Layered Entry Ledge: each new agent identity must post a non-refundable entry deposit that is released only after 90 days of verified activity, and any identity flagged as a duplicate forfeits the full deposit plus a fixed penalty charged to the funding wallet. Clones therefore cost real money with near-zero recovery odds. Reputation weighting under a cedar trust score decays slowly, so cloned identities stay low-value for months. A willow audit trail logs every linked wallet, making each additional clone progressively easier to detect and more expensive.
